lines: 1. Name the principles the motion uses (anticipation, timing, arcs, follow through, slow in and slow out, exaggeration...).
2. Go through the checklist: player response first, tails stop without a snap on interruption, ragdoll or death.
3. In the report: principle -> how it is applied; what only eyes can check goes to [visual].
Interface edit — follow .claude/rules/ui.md and check against .claude/docs/ui-principles.md:
1. A reference from the user exists; the layout is a prepared template, code only clones it and changes content.
2. Empty transparent buttons with visual children, center anchors, SizeConstraint for proportions, wrapped UIListLayout with spacing in the template cell.
3. One font family per window, currency in every purchase button, buttons away from window edges, landscape phone readability.
4. In the report: the principles the screen relies on; readability and feel go to [visual].
